signals.name: Netflix, Inc.
signals.label: Bipartisan Congress keeps buying the dip
signals.detail: Rep. Cleo Fields (D-LA) has bought Netflix eight times since November 2025 (most recently Sept. 14, 2026, disclosed Oct. 1), while Rep. Byron Donalds (R-FL) has bought it four times since March (most recently Aug. 12, disclosed Sept. 15) -- a Democrat and a Republican both dollar-cost-averaging into the same falling stock as it slid toward 52-week lows. Benzinga estimated Fields' cumulative ~$1.145M of NFLX purchases were underwater by roughly $461,000 (2.65x his annual salary) as of mid-October.
signals.takeaway: Watch whether this bipartisan congressional dip-buying marks a contrarian bottom call or just two lawmakers averaging down into a continued decline.

signals.name: CACI International Inc.
signals.label: Two House Republicans, one border-drone contractor, a Q1 beat
signals.detail: Rep. Lisa McClain (R-MI) bought CACI on Sept. 14, 2026 (disclosed Oct. 12), while Rep. Michael McCaul's wife has made six disclosed CACI trades since early 2025. CACI then beat fiscal Q1 2027 estimates on Oct. 21-22 (adjusted EPS $7.66 vs. $6.67 expected) and separately won a Department of War contract to deploy its SkyValor counter-drone system at the southern border.
signals.takeaway: Watch whether CACI's earnings beat and border-drone contract win vindicate both lawmakers' holdings, or whether the committee-overlap optics draw fresh ethics scrutiny.

signals.name: SpaceX
signals.label: Eight members of Congress holding into (and around) earnings
signals.detail: Benzinga counted eight current Congress members with disclosed SpaceX stakes heading into its Oct. 20, 2026 Q3 earnings. SpaceX then beat on earnings with capex below expectations, but Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar had already trimmed part of her stake on Sept. 24, just weeks after adding to it.
signals.takeaway: Watch whether the remaining holders stay in after the beat, or whether Salazar's quick add-then-trim is the first sign of broader profit-taking.

signals.name: First Majestic Silver Corp. / silver miners (SLV, SILJ)
signals.label: Shorts cover, retail turns bullish, Zacks turns bearish -- same week
signals.detail: Silver miners sold off hard into Oct. 22 (AG -5.4%, HL -6.1% per portfolio price spine) as oil-driven inflation/rate fears hit the complex, yet Stocktwits retail sentiment on SLV flipped more bullish with elevated message volume even as the tape fell, and First Majestic (AG) had already seen significant short covering amid the preceding rally. Zacks Research cut AG to Strong Sell on Oct. 22 -- the same day retail sentiment was turning more constructive.
signals.takeaway: Watch whether retail dip-buying and short covering are early or late relative to Zacks' fresh Strong Sell call on the same name.

signals.name: Cisco Systems, Inc.
signals.label: Same ticker, same day, opposite conviction in Congress
signals.detail: On Sept. 24, 2026, Sen. John Boozman (R-AR) bought Cisco Systems while Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar (R-FL) sold it from her own accounts -- both disclosed within two weeks of each other (Oct. 21 and Oct. 7). Salazar's Cisco sale was part of a broader multi-stock liquidation that also hit Microsoft, Meta, Salesforce and Snowflake the same day.
signals.takeaway: Watch for more same-party, same-day splits like this as a reminder that congressional trades reflect many individual, often adviser-directed decisions, not a unified view.
